claim: Inert design of trusted-host emergency termination of one controller-created VM primary process and managed restart inhibition.
authority: No native Windows process/job calls, overlay, guest, QEMU startup, NIC, host share, QMP or termination is implemented or permitted by this contract.
intended_native_creation: CreateProcessW explicit application, no inherited handles, CREATE_SUSPENDED and atomic PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_JOB_LIST
verify and persist retained process identity
resume only if no stop latch
intended_native_stop: validate human scope, generation, epoch and replay counter
on persistence failure still attempt emergency termination on already retained exact target, report durability unconfirmed
TerminateProcess on same validated retained handle
independent judge observes signaled query-only process handle
recovery: Never reopen by PID/name. Controller crash intentionally stops the job. Reload always inhibits admission. Missing judge handle or evidence remains UNKNOWN. Human reset plus new approval and separate explicit start required.
judge: Native acceptance requires a separate process outside the job, holding only query/synchronize rights and pre-stop liveness. Current MockJudge is only an in-process simulator. No job/terminate handle transfer.
resource_limits: INTENDED, not enforced or released: one VM primary process, no breakaway/children, one TCG vCPU, 2 GiB guest RAM, 3 GiB whole-job memory, 15-minute independent supervisor deadline. Disk/log hard bounds need separately accepted enforcement; free-space checks are not reservations.

artifacts_for_later_review.limits: These are observed byte identities, not signatures, safe-startup proof or execution authority. Firmware/device/provisioning and all payload dependencies remain separately reviewed.

durability_limit: Exclusive pending file, file flush/fsync and replace model restart persistence. No Windows power-loss guarantee. Missing, malformed, changed-contract or pending state inhibits admission.
collateral: Intended native hard stop and controller loss interrupt the entire chosen VM and may corrupt its disposable overlay. No graceful shutdown, selective AI stopping, external-job cancellation or resistance to trusted-host compromise is established.
native_release_gates: actual Win32 API and atomic job support
handle ownership and independent judge process
enforceable memory, CPU, disk/log and deadline bounds
exact destructive execution grant and direct Risk acceptance
